# SPACO — Premium Self-Service Multifunctional Event Spaces in Hong Kong

> SPACO is a Hong Kong-based premium self-service multifunctional event space
> operator with four branches across Causeway Bay, Wan Chai, Sheung Wan, and
> Tsim Sha Tsui. We host family parties, corporate events, casual gatherings,
> and poker nights with full BBQ, hotpot, pool, mahjong, and shisha
> facilities. All branches operate 24 hours, every day. Online booking with
> instant confirmation, deposit by Stripe/FPS, refundable post-event deposit.
> Operated by Cholliman Incorporation Limited.

### 3. Sheung Wan Harbour View 上環海景旗艦店
Located at 22/F, Kam Yau Building, 70-72 Connaught Road West, Sheung Wan
(上環干諾道西 70-72 號金有大廈 22 樓). The floor is split into three bookable
configurations sharing the same physical space:

- **Room A**: 1,000 sq ft, capacity 6–35, HK$50–58/head — tranquil, outdoor BBQ area, family-friendly
- **Room B**: 2,200 sq ft, capacity 20–70, HK$50–58/head — private professional kitchen, pool table, hotpot
- **Full Floor (A+B)**: 3,200 sq ft, capacity 25–100, HK$50–58/head — entire floor exclusive

Booking conflict: Booking A blocks the full floor; booking full floor blocks A
and B; etc.

Page: https://spacohk.com/en/branches/sheung-wan

### 4. Tsim Sha Tsui 尖沙咀店

## Services & Add-ons

### Venue rental
- Hourly per-person charges + minimum guest/hour requirements (varies by venue and weekday/weekend)
- Refundable security deposit added at booking (tiered: HK$1k / 2k / 4k against rental subtotal)
- 24/7 self-service access via smart-lock with one-time passcode sent before event

### Food & drinks (add-ons)
- BBQ packages: standard (HK$158/head, meat & balls) or deluxe (HK$328/head, seafood + meat + balls + vegetables)
- Hotpot package: HK$168/head (requires 3-day advance booking)
- Unlimited non-alcoholic drinks: per-head charge (varies by branch)
- BYOB / BYOF allowed at most branches

### Entertainment
- Pool table (Sheung Wan, Causeway Bay)
- Mahjong tables (auto-shuffle, 4-player)
- Shisha (variable pipes/heads, multiple flavours, optional staff setup +HK$180)
- Karaoke (selected branches)
- Poker tables

### Packages
- **Corporate Chill Package**: HK$4,800 flat — 3-hour exclusive, unlimited non-alcoholic drinks, projector + AV included
- **Mahjong 4-person Package**: HK$1,200 flat (weekday) — 8-hour exclusive, 4-player auto-shuffle mahjong, unlimited soft drinks (~HK$300/head)
- **Family Party Packages**: birthday & themed decoration add-ons available

### Decoration
- Optional themed decoration packages (Hong Kong birthday party setups, kids themes, etc.)
- Customisable via WhatsApp consultation

---

## Pricing structure

All prices in HKD.

| Component | How it's charged |
|---|---|
| Venue rental | (per-head rate) × (guest count) × (hours) — branch- and day-dependent |
| Refundable deposit (按金) | Tiered: ≤ HK$4,000 → HK$1,000 · ≤ HK$10,000 → HK$2,000 · > HK$10,000 → HK$4,000 |
| Upfront deposit (today) | Full grand total when ≤ HK$10,000; 50% when > HK$10,000 (balance due 2 days before event) |
| Add-ons | Per-person (BBQ, hotpot, drinks) or flat (shisha base) |
| Children 1–9 years | Charged at half rate for per-head items; counted as 0.5 adult for minimum-guest rules |

Peak days = Friday, Saturday, public holiday, and the eve of a public
holiday. Peak pricing adds HK$8/head and tightens minimums (e.g. 20 guests,
5 hours at Causeway Bay).

---

## Booking process

1. Browse branches at https://spacohk.com — pick venue, date, time
2. Select guest count (adults + children) and add-ons (BBQ, hotpot, drinks, shisha, etc.)
3. Fill WhatsApp contact + agree to booking guidelines
4. Confirm booking → fill deposit-refund destination (FPS or bank transfer)
5. Pay deposit online (Stripe; KPay support in progress) — or pay offline via FPS with receipt upload
6. Receive booking confirmation + smart-lock passcode 1–2 days before event
7. Self-service: enter venue, enjoy event, clean up before timed exit
8. Refundable deposit returned within 24 hours after event (less deductions for any damage/over-time)

Cancellation: see https://spacohk.com/en/guidelines for full policy. Generally, cancellations refundable up to a cutoff period before event date.

## Booking & payment FAQ highlights

**Q: How long does it take to confirm a booking?**
A: Instant. Once deposit is paid online (or admin confirms offline FPS), the booking is locked and smart-lock passcode is queued.

**Q: When do I get the smart-lock access code?**
A: Sent via WhatsApp 1–2 days before the event date. Active only during your booked time window plus a small buffer.

**Q: Can I extend my booking on the day?**
A: Yes, contact us via WhatsApp. We'll check availability and process the top-up payment via FPS.

**Q: Is there a cleaning fee?**
A: No, but please leave the venue in the condition you found it. Damage or excessive cleaning will be deducted from the refundable deposit.

**Q: Can I bring my own food and drinks (BYOF / BYOB)?**
A: Yes at most branches. Some branches have BYOB restrictions for specific package types — check the branch page.

**Q: Are pets allowed?**
A: Case-by-case. Please ask via WhatsApp before booking.

**Q: How are deposit refunds processed?**
A: Within 24 hours after your event ends, refunded via FPS or bank transfer to the destination you specified at booking. If deductions apply (damage, over-time, extra cleaning), an itemised statement is sent and the remainder refunded.
